Users need to change the order of the rows to find and review tasks quickly.","business_value":"Users can review tasks in the order that matters to them without exporting the data.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different Creation Dates","when":"The user selects the sort option Creation Date","then":"The table rows are reordered so that the Creation Date values are in a single consistent order (ascending or descending, as defined by the sort control) and the sort option shown as selected is Creation Date"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays tasks with different Due Dates","when":"The user selects the sort option Due Date","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Due Date field and the sort option shown as selected is Due Date"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays tasks with different Status values","when":"The user selects the sort option Status","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Status field and the sort option shown as selected is Status"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays tasks with different Priority values","when":"The user selects the sort option Priority","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Priority field and the sort option shown as selected is Priority"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different Titles","when":"The user selects the sort option Title","then":"The table rows are reordered so that the Title values are in a single consistent alphabetical order (ascending or descending, as defined by the sort control) and the sort option shown as selected is Title"},{"given":"The report API is called with a sort field of creation_date, due_date, status, priority or title","when":"The request is processed by the backend","then":"The response contains the matching tasks ordered by that field"},{"given":"The report API is called with a sort field that is not one of creation_date, the page loads."],"dependencies":[],"definition_of_done":["Sort control offers Creation Date, Due Date, Status, Priority and Title","Each sort option reorders the report table and shows the selected
